children: The stock market seems complicated, but it doesn't have to be. ChartWatch LIVE Webinars take the guesswork and confusion out of investing by teaching you a clear set of rules to help allocate your capital and manage your risk in the markets.
Click the "Watch on YouTube" button in the player above, or go to our YouTube page, to check out our other fantastic technical analysis videos when you're done with this one!

If you attended, I trust that you enjoyed the session and leant plenty about how to think and act like a trend following technical analyst. If you weren't able to make it, or if you haven't registered yet, then I hope you can join me Wednesday, 18 November, at 12:00pm AEDTfor the next instalment. Be sure to bring an open mind about investing plus your favourite ASX stock for me to analyse!

Learn more about technical analysis and trend following through real case studies on ASX stocks. Australia's premier technical analyst, Carl Capolingua, shares his unique insights on stocks as requested by viewers. Ask about a company in your portfolio or anything related to trading and investing and get Carl's expert opinion.
There’s so much uncertainty in global stock markets, with war, soaring oil prices, rampant inflation and an AI trade that appears to be on the brink of unravelling.
And yet, the major Australian share market index is trading at a fresh record high once dividends are accounted for – it just doesn’t make sense!

Unless, of course, you’re a ChartWatch LIVE viewer. If that’s the case, then you know exactly what’s going on, how to spot strong trends and how to manage your risk. If you’re not a ChartWatch viewer... then you’d better keep reading!
